ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Tile
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
    Upgrade Picker Script (SHARED UI VERSION)
    ---------------------------------
    Changes made:
    - UI is now shared, all players see the same window and the same navigation state
    - Removed per-player UI state tables from the UI flow (search, tabs, index are shared)
    - Removed UI visibility filtering (no visibility="Red"/"Blue" on the main panel)
    - List (Upgrades, Admirals) spawner window is also shared, all players can see what is pasted/edited

    Notes:
    - Spawning still occurs to the CLICKING player's configured spawn area
    - Tooltips were removed to avoid per-player hover state fighting in a shared UI
--]]

--==============================================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--==============================================================================

CONFIG = {
    -- Faction name (used in broadcasts and UI title)
    FACTION_NAME = "UPGRADE",

    -- UI appearance settings
    UI = {
        -- Main panel dimensions
        PANEL_WIDTH = 720,
        PANEL_HEIGHT = 820,

        -- Card grid settings (legacy, kept for compatibility)
        CARDS_PER_ROW = 3,
        CARD_WIDTH = 350,
        CARD_HEIGHT = 490,
        CARD_SPACING = 10,

        -- Colors
        PANEL_COLOR = "rgba(0.1, 0.1, 0.15, 1)",
        TAB_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 1)",
        TAB_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 1)",
        CARD_COLOR = "rgba(0.25, 0.25, 0.35, 1)",
        CARD_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1)",
        BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1)",
        CLOSE_BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1)",
        TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFF",
        SEARCH_BG_COLOR = "rgba(0.15, 0.15, 0.2, 1)",

        -- Element size controls
        SEARCH_ROW_HEIGHT = 28,
        SEARCH_INPUT_WIDTH = 200,
        CLEAR_BUTTON_WIDTH = 100,
        CLEAR_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,
        CLOSE_BUTTON_WIDTH = 28,
        CLOSE_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,
        TABS_ROW_HEIGHT = 26,
        ARROW_BUTTON_WIDTH = 50,
        SPAWN_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 45,

        -- Font sizes
        FONT_SIZE_SEARCH = 13,
        FONT_SIZE_TABS = 18,
        FONT_SIZE_CLASS_TABS = 12,
        FONT_SIZE_ARROWS = 60,
        FONT_SIZE_SPAWN = 32,
        FONT_SIZE_CLOSE = 14,

        -- Tooltip sizing (kept, but tooltips are disabled in shared UI)
        TOOLTIP_WIDTH = 600,
        TOOLTIP_HEIGHT = 90,
        TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE = 29,
    },

    -- Player spawn positions (where first card spawns for each player color)
    -- Cards spawn left-to-right from this position
    PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS = {
        ["Red"] = {
            position = {x = -47.08, y = 1.36, z = 9.78},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 270, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = -1},
        },
        ["Blue"] = {
            position = {x = 47.08, y = 1.36, z = -9.78},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 90, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1},
        },
    },

    -- Spacing between spawned cards
    CARD_SPAWN_SPACING = 2.92,

    -- Faction categories based on Faction property in card scripts
    FACTION_CATEGORIES = {
        "UCM", "Shaltari", "Resistance", "Scourge", "PHR", "Bioficer"
    }
}

--==============================================================================
-- STATE VARIABLES
--==============================================================================

-- Maps fleet list faction names to internal faction codes
FACTION_NAME_MAP = {
    ["united colonies of mankind"] = "UCM",
    ["ucm"] = "UCM",
    ["shaltari"] = "Shaltari",
    ["shaltari tribes"] = "Shaltari",
    ["resistance"] = "Resistance",
    ["the resistance"] = "Resistance",
    ["scourge"] = "Scourge",
    ["the scourge"] = "Scourge",
    ["post-human republic"] = "PHR",
    ["phr"] = "PHR",
    ["bioficer"] = "Bioficer",
    ["bioficers"] = "Bioficer",
}

savedUpgradeCards = {}
savedUpgradeCardsBackup = {}

-- Legacy per-player tables (kept so other parts of your script do not explode)
playerSelections = {}
playerCardIndices = {}
playerSearchFilters = {}
playerActiveTabs = {}
playerSpawnCounts = {}
playerListInputs = {}
playerListUIVisible = {}
playerListInputText = {}

-- Shared UI state (NEW)
sharedUpgradeUIOpen = false
sharedListUIOpen = false
sharedSearchFilter = ""
sharedActiveTab = "All"
sharedCardIndex = 1
sharedListInputText = ""

fresh = true
selfGUID = ""

--==============================================================================
-- SAVE/LOAD FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function updateSave()
    local script = self.getLuaScript()

    local dataStartPattern = "\n%-%-EMBEDDED_DATA_START"
    local dataStart = script:find(dataStartPattern)

    if dataStart then
        script = script:sub(1, dataStart - 1)
    end

    local embeddedData = "\n--EMBEDDED_DATA_START\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "savedUpgradeCards = {\n"

    for i, card in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  {\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    name = [====[" .. (card.name or "Unknown") .. "]====],\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    imageURL = [====[" .. (card.imageURL or "") .. "]====],\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    faction = [====[" .. (card.faction or "Other") .. "]====],\n"
        if card.json then
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    json = [====[" .. card.json .. "]====],\n"
        end
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  },\n"
    end

    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "}\n\n"
    embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"

    script = script .. embeddedData
    self.setLuaScript(script)
end

function onLoad(saved_data)
    selfGUID = self.getGUID()

    if savedUpgradeCards == nil then
        savedUpgradeCards = {}
    end
    if fresh == nil then
        fresh = true
    end

    if #savedUpgradeCards > 0 then
        fresh = false
    end

    playerSelections = {}
    playerCardIndices = {}
    playerSearchFilters = {}
    playerActiveTabs = {}
    playerSpawnCounts = {}

    for _, card in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
        if card.json then card.json = stripBrackets(card.json) end
        if card.imageURL then card.imageURL = stripBrackets(card.imageURL) end
    end

    -- Initialise shared UI defaults
    sharedUpgradeUIOpen = false
    sharedListUIOpen = false
    sharedSearchFilter = ""
    sharedActiveTab = "All"
    sharedCardIndex = 1
    sharedListInputText = ""

    if fresh then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtonsWithList()
    end
end

function detectFactionFromList(lines)
    if #lines == 0 then return nil end

    local firstLine = lines[1]:lower()

    for pattern, factionCode in pairs(FACTION_NAME_MAP) do
        if contains(firstLine, pattern) then
            return factionCode
        end
    end

    for i = 2, math.min(3, #lines) do
        local line = lines[i]:lower()
        for pattern, factionCode in pairs(FACTION_NAME_MAP) do
            if contains(line, pattern) then
                return factionCode
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

--==============================================================================
-- BUTTON CREATION FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function createButton_helper(params)
    local defaults = {
        function_owner = self,
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1}
    }

    local buttonConfig = {}
    for k, v in pairs(defaults) do
        buttonConfig[k] = v
    end
    for k, v in pairs(params) do
        buttonConfig[k] = v
    end

    self.createButton(buttonConfig)
end

function createSetupButton()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()

    createButton_helper({
        label = "Setup",
        click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
        position = {0, 1, 0},
        height = 350,
        width = 800,
        font_size = 250,
        color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3}
    })
end

function createMainButtonsWithList()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()

    -- View Upgrades button (main action) - grey color
    createButton_helper({
        label = "View Upgrades",
        click_function = "buttonClick_viewUpgrades",
        position = {0, 1, 1.1},
        height = 320,
        width = 1400,
        font_size = 210,
        color = {0.31, 0.31, 0.31},
        scale = {0.4, 0.4, 0.4}
    })

    -- Upgrade Spawner button
    createButton_helper({
        label = "Spawn Upgrades by List",
        click_function = "buttonClick_spawnFromList",
        position = {0, 1, 1.35},
        height = 320,
        width = 1600,
        font_size = 120,
        color = {0.2, 0.6, 0.4},
        scale = {0.4, 0.4, 0.4}
    })

    -- Setup button (to modify saved cards)
    createButton_helper({
        label = "Setup",
        click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
        position = {0.85, 1, 1.05},
        height = 230,
        width = 550,
        font_size = 200,
        color = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1},
        font_color = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
        scale = {0.2, 0.2, 0.2}
    })
end

function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    self.clearInputs()

    local btnHeight = 60
    local btnWidth  = 380
    local btnFont   = 60
    local zStart    = 1.2
    local zSpacing  = -0.25

    -- Cancel button (top)
    createButton_helper({
        label = "Cancel",
        click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
        position = {0, 1, zStart},
        height = btnHeight,
        width = btnWidth,
        font_size = btnFont,
        color = {0.4, 0.2, 0.2}
    })

    -- Add button (below Cancel)
    createButton_helper({
        label = "Add Upgrades",
        click_function = "buttonClick_add",
        position = {0, 1, zStart + zSpacing},
        height = btnHeight,
        width = btnWidth,
        font_size = btnFont,
        color = {0.2, 0.5, 0.2}
    })

    -- Remove button (only if cards exist)
    if not fresh then
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Remove Upgrades",
            click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
            position = {0, 1, zStart + (2 * zSpacing)},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.5, 0.2, 0.2}
        })
    end

    -- Reset button (bottom)
    createButton_helper({
        label = "Reset",
        click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
        position = {0, 1, zStart + (3 * zSpacing)},
        height = btnHeight,
        width = btnWidth,
        font_size = btnFont,
        color = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3}
    })
end

--==============================================================================
-- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function buttonClick_setup()
    savedUpgradeCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedUpgradeCards)
    createSetupActionButtons()
    broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select upgrade cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_cancel()
    savedUpgradeCards = savedUpgradeCardsBackup

    if #savedUpgradeCards == 0 then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtonsWithList()
    end

    broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    local count = 0

    for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
        if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
            if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                local alreadyExists = false

                for _, saved in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
                    if saved.name == cardName then
                        alreadyExists = true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not alreadyExists then
                    local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                    if cardData then
                        table.insert(savedUpgradeCards, cardData)
                        count = count + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if count > 0 then
        fresh = false
        sortUpgradeCards()
        updateSave()
        broadcastToAll(count .. " upgrade card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
    else
        broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
    end

    createMainButtonsWithList()
end

function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
    local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
    local count = 0

    local newSavedCards = {}

    for _, saved in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
        local shouldRemove = false

        for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
            if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                    shouldRemove = true
                    count = count + 1
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if not shouldRemove then
            table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
        end
    end

    savedUpgradeCards = newSavedCards

    if #savedUpgradeCards == 0 then
        fresh = true
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtonsWithList()
    end

    updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(count .. " upgrade card(s) removed from " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Picker", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
end

function buttonClick_reset()
    fresh = true
    savedUpgradeCards = {}
    savedUpgradeCardsBackup = {}
    playerSelections = {}
    playerSearchFilters = {}
    playerActiveTabs = {}
    playerSpawnCounts = {}

    -- Shared UI reset too
    sharedUpgradeUIOpen = false
    sharedListUIOpen = false
    sharedSearchFilter = ""
    sharedActiveTab = "All"
    sharedCardIndex = 1
    sharedListInputText = ""

    createSetupButton()
    updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
end

--==============================================================================
-- CARD DATA EXTRACTION
--==============================================================================

function extractCardData(cardObj)
    if not cardObj then return nil end

    if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
        broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
        return nil
    end

    local cardData = {
        name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Upgrade",
        json = nil,
        imageURL = "",
        faction = "Other",
    }

    cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

    local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
    if customObj and customObj.image then
        cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
    end

    local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
    if script then
        local scriptLower = string.lower(script)
        local factionPos = scriptLower:find("faction%s*=")

        if factionPos then
            local afterEquals = script:sub(factionPos)
            local faction = afterEquals:match('=%s*"([^"]+)"')
            if not faction then
                faction = afterEquals:match("=%s*'([^']+)'")
            end

            if faction then
                cardData.faction = faction
            else
                cardData.faction = "Other"
            end
        else
            cardData.faction = "Other"
        end
		broadcastToAll("Card: " .. cardData.name .. " | Faction: " .. cardData.faction, {1,1,1})
    end
	

    return cardData
end

function sortUpgradeCards()
    table.sort(savedUpgradeCards, function(a, b)
        return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
    end)
end

--==============================================================================
-- VIEW UPGRADES UI FUNCTIONS (SHARED)
--==============================================================================

function buttonClick_viewUpgrades(obj, player_color)
    if #savedUpgradeCards == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No upgrades saved! Use Setup to add upgrade cards.", player_color, {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        return
    end

    -- Opening upgrades UI closes list UI (single window shared)
    sharedListUIOpen = false
    sharedUpgradeUIOpen = true

    -- Ensure sane defaults
    if not sharedSearchFilter then sharedSearchFilter = "" end
    if not sharedActiveTab then sharedActiveTab = "All" end
    if not sharedCardIndex or sharedCardIndex < 1 then sharedCardIndex = 1 end

    self.clearButtons()
    showUpgradePickerUI()
end

function showUpgradePickerUI()
    if not sharedUpgradeUIOpen then return end
    local upgradePickerXML = generateUpgradePickerXML_SHARED()
    self.UI.setXml(upgradePickerXML)
end

function generateUpgradePickerXML_SHARED()
    local cfg = CONFIG.UI
    local activeTab = sharedActiveTab or "All"
    local searchFilter = sharedSearchFilter or ""
    local currentIndex = sharedCardIndex or 1

    local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, searchFilter)
    local totalCards = #filteredCards

    if totalCards == 0 then
        currentIndex = 0
    elseif currentIndex > totalCards then
        currentIndex = 1
        sharedCardIndex = 1
    elseif currentIndex < 1 then
        currentIndex = 1
        sharedCardIndex = 1
    end

    local currentCard = nil
    if currentIndex > 0 then
        currentCard = filteredCards[currentIndex]
    end

    local panelWidth = cfg.PANEL_WIDTH
    local panelHeight = cfg.PANEL_HEIGHT
    local searchRowHeight = cfg.SEARCH_ROW_HEIGHT
    local tabsRowHeight = cfg.TABS_ROW_HEIGHT
    local spawnButtonHeight = cfg.SPAWN_BUTTON_HEIGHT
    local arrowWidth = cfg.ARROW_BUTTON_WIDTH
    local closeWidth = cfg.CLOSE_BUTTON_WIDTH
    local closeHeight = cfg.CLOSE_BUTTON_HEIGHT
    local clearWidth = cfg.CLEAR_BUTTON_WIDTH
    local clearHeight = cfg.CLEAR_BUTTON_HEIGHT
    local searchInputWidth = cfg.SEARCH_INPUT_WIDTH

    local xml = [[
    <Panel id="upgradePickerPanel"
           width="]] .. panelWidth .. [["
           height="]] .. panelHeight .. [["
           color="]] .. cfg.PANEL_COLOR .. [["
           position="0 10 -110"
           rotation="0 0 180"
           scale=".28 .28 .28"
           allowDragging="false"
           returnToOriginalPositionWhenReleased="false">

        <VerticalLayout padding="8 8 8 8" spacing="4"
                        childForceExpandHeight="false"
                        childForceExpandWidth="true">

            <!-- ROW 1: SEARCH, CLEAR, CLOSE -->
            <HorizontalLayout minHeight="]] .. searchRowHeight .. [["
                              preferredHeight="]] .. searchRowHeight .. [["
                              flexibleHeight="0"
                              spacing="4"
                              childForceExpandHeight="true"
                              childForceExpandWidth="false">

                <Panel flexibleWidth="1" minWidth="0"/>

                <InputField id="searchInput"
                        onEndEdit="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiSearchChanged"
                        placeholder="Search"
                        minWidth="]] .. searchInputWidth .. [["
                        preferredWidth="]] .. searchInputWidth .. [["
                        flexibleWidth="0"
                        minHeight="]] .. searchRowHeight .. [["
                        preferredHeight="]] .. searchRowHeight .. [["
                        alignment="MiddleCenter"
                        color="]] .. cfg.SEARCH_BG_COLOR .. [["
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_SEARCH .. [[">]] .. searchFilter .. [[</InputField>

                <Button id="clearSearchButton"
                        onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiClearSearch"
                        minWidth="]] .. clearWidth .. [["
                        preferredWidth="]] .. clearWidth .. [["
                        flexibleWidth="0"
                        minHeight="]] .. clearHeight .. [["
                        preferredHeight="]] .. clearHeight .. [["
                        color="rgba(0.4,0.4,0.4,1)"
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_TABS .. [[">Clear</Button>

                <Panel flexibleWidth="1" minWidth="0"/>

                <Button id="closeButton"
                        onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiCloseButton"
                        minWidth="]] .. closeWidth .. [["
                        preferredWidth="]] .. closeWidth .. [["
                        flexibleWidth="0"
                        minHeight="]] .. closeHeight .. [["
                        preferredHeight="]] .. closeHeight .. [["
                        color="]] .. cfg.CLOSE_BUTTON_COLOR .. [["
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_CLOSE .. [["
                        fontStyle="Bold">X</Button>
            </HorizontalLayout>

            <!-- ROW 2: FACTION TABS -->
            <HorizontalLayout minHeight="]] .. tabsRowHeight .. [["
                              preferredHeight="]] .. tabsRowHeight .. [["
                              flexibleHeight="0"
                              spacing="2"
                              childForceExpandHeight="true"
                              childForceExpandWidth="true">
    ]]

    -- "All" tab
    local allTabColor = (activeTab == "All") and cfg.TAB_SELECTED_COLOR or cfg.TAB_COLOR
    xml = xml .. [[
                <Button id="tabAll"
                        onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiTabClicked(All)"
                        flexibleWidth="1"
                        minHeight="]] .. tabsRowHeight .. [["
                        preferredHeight="]] .. tabsRowHeight .. [["
                        color="]] .. allTabColor .. [["
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_CLASS_TABS .. [[">All</Button>
    ]]

    for _, faction in ipairs(CONFIG.FACTION_CATEGORIES) do
        local tabColor = (activeTab == faction) and cfg.TAB_SELECTED_COLOR or cfg.TAB_COLOR
        xml = xml .. [[
                <Button id="tab]] .. faction .. [["
                        onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiTabClicked(]] .. faction .. [[)"
                        flexibleWidth="1"
                        minHeight="]] .. tabsRowHeight .. [["
                        preferredHeight="]] .. tabsRowHeight .. [["
                        color="]] .. tabColor .. [["
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_CLASS_TABS .. [[">]] .. faction .. [[</Button>
    ]]
    end

    xml = xml .. [[
            </HorizontalLayout>

            <!-- ROW 3: MAIN CONTENT (Arrows + Image) -->
            <HorizontalLayout spacing="4"
                              flexibleHeight="1"
                              minHeight="100"
                              childForceExpandHeight="true"
                              childForceExpandWidth="false">

                <Button onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiPrevCard"
                        minWidth="]] .. arrowWidth .. [["
                        preferredWidth="]] .. arrowWidth .. [["
                        flexibleWidth="0"
                        flexibleHeight="1"
                        color="rgba(0.3,0.3,0.4,0.8)"
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_ARROWS .. [["
                        fontStyle="Bold"><</Button>

                <Panel color="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"
                       flexibleWidth="1"
                       flexibleHeight="1"
                       minWidth="100">
    ]]

    if currentCard then
        xml = xml .. [[
                    <Image image="]] .. escapeXml(currentCard.imageURL) .. [["
                           preserveAspect="true"
                           rectAlignment="MiddleCenter"/>
    ]]
    else
        xml = xml .. [[
                    <Text fontSize="16" color="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [[" alignment="MiddleCenter">No upgrades found</Text>
    ]]
    end

    xml = xml .. [[
                </Panel>

                <Button onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiNextCard"
                        minWidth="]] .. arrowWidth .. [["
                        preferredWidth="]] .. arrowWidth .. [["
                        flexibleWidth="0"
                        flexibleHeight="1"
                        color="rgba(0.3,0.3,0.4,0.8)"
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_ARROWS .. [["
                        fontStyle="Bold">></Button>
            </HorizontalLayout>

            <!-- ROW 4: SPAWN BUTTON -->
            <HorizontalLayout minHeight="]] .. spawnButtonHeight .. [["
                              preferredHeight="]] .. spawnButtonHeight .. [["
                              flexibleHeight="0"
                              childForceExpandWidth="true"
                              childForceExpandHeight="true">
                <Button id="spawnButton"
                        onClick="]] .. selfGUID .. [[/uiSpawnCards"
                        flexibleWidth="1"
                        minHeight="]] .. spawnButtonHeight .. [["
                        preferredHeight="]] .. spawnButtonHeight .. [["
                        color="]] .. cfg.BUTTON_COLOR .. [["
                        textColor="]] .. cfg.TEXT_COLOR .. [["
                        fontSize="]] .. cfg.FONT_SIZE_SPAWN .. [["
                        fontStyle="Bold">Spawn Upgrade Card</Button>
            </HorizontalLayout>

        </VerticalLayout>
    </Panel>
    ]]

    return xml
end

function getFilteredCards(activeTab, searchFilter)
    local filtered = {}
    local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

    for i, card in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
        local matchesTab = (activeTab == "All") or (card.faction == activeTab)
        local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

        if matchesTab and matchesSearch then
            local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
            cardCopy.originalIndex = i
            table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
        end
    end

    return filtered
end

function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
    local count = 0
    for _, card in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
        if card.faction == categoryName then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

function countSelections(playerColor)
    return 0
end

function escapeXml(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    str = str:gsub("&", "&")
    str = str:gsub("<", "<")
    str = str:gsub(">", ">")
    str = str:gsub('"', """)
    str = str:gsub("'", "'")
    return str
end

--==============================================================================
-- UI CALLBACK FUNCTIONS (SHARED)
--==============================================================================

function uiCloseButton(player, value, id)
    sharedUpgradeUIOpen = false

function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
    if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

    local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]

    if not spawnConfig then
        spawnConfig = {
            position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
        }
        broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using centre.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end

    local startPos = spawnConfig.position
    local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
    local direction = spawnConfig.direction
    local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING

    local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

    for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
        local card = savedUpgradeCards[cardIndex]
        if card and card.json then
            local offset = currentCount * spacing
            local spawnPos = {
                x = startPos.x + (direction.x * offset),
                y = startPos.y + (direction.y * offset),
                z = startPos.z + (direction.z * offset),
            }

            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = card.json,
                position = spawnPos,
                rotation = rotation,
                sound = true,
            })

            currentCount = currentCount + 1
        end
    end

    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end

    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        if type(v) == "table" then
            newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
        else
            newTable[k] = v
        end
    end
    return newTable
end

function round(num, dec)
    local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function stripBrackets(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
    if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end

    s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
    if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end

    return str
end

function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
    local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)

    local detectedFaction = detectFactionFromList(lines)
    if detectedFaction then
        broadcastToColor("Detected faction: " .. detectedFaction, playerColor, {0.5, 0.8, 1})
    else
        broadcastToColor("Could not detect faction from list. Searching all factions.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end

    local upgradeEntries = extractUpgradeEntries(lines)

    if #upgradeEntries == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No upgrades found in the list.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
        return
    end

    local spawnedCount = 0
    local notFoundList = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(upgradeEntries) do
        local quantity = entry.quantity
        local upgradeName = entry.name
        local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(upgradeName, detectedFaction, entry.shipContext)

        if #matchedCards > 0 then
            local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
            for i = 1, quantity do
                spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {cardIndex})
                spawnedCount = spawnedCount + 1
            end
        else
            local alreadyListed = false
            for _, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
                if name == upgradeName then
                    alreadyListed = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if not alreadyListed then
                table.insert(notFoundList, upgradeName)
            end
        end
    end

    if spawnedCount > 0 then
        broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " upgrade cards from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
    end

    if #notFoundList > 0 then
        local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
        for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
            if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
            notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
            if i >= 5 then
                notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                break
            end
        end
        broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end
end

function splitIntoLines(text)
    local lines = {}
    local currentLine = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local char = text:sub(i, i)
        if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
            if #currentLine > 0 then
                table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                currentLine = ""
            end
        else
            currentLine = currentLine .. char
        end
    end
    if #currentLine > 0 then
        table.insert(lines, currentLine)
    end
    return lines
end

function removeLineNumber(line)
    local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
    if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
        local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
        if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
            return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
        end
    end
    return line
end

function extractUpgradeEntries(lines)
    local entries = {}
    local currentShipContext = nil

    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
        line = trimString(line)
        local lineLower = line:lower()

        if #line == 0 then
            goto continue
        end

        if contains(lineLower, "## colossal") then
            currentShipContext = "Dreadnought"
            goto continue
        elseif contains(lineLower, "## heavy") then
            currentShipContext = "Heavy"
            goto continue
        elseif contains(lineLower, "## medium") then
            currentShipContext = "Cruiser"
            goto continue
        elseif contains(lineLower, "## light") then
            currentShipContext = "Frigate"
            goto continue
        elseif contains(lineLower, "## admirals") then
            currentShipContext = nil
            goto continue
        elseif contains(lineLower, "## space stations") then
            currentShipContext = nil
            goto continue
        end

        if isHeaderLine(line) then
            goto continue
        end

        if contains(lineLower, "dreadnought") and contains(line, "pts]") then
            currentShipContext = "Dreadnought"
        elseif contains(lineLower, "battleship") and contains(line, "pts]") then
            currentShipContext = "Heavy"
        elseif contains(lineLower, "frigate") and contains(line, "pts]") then
            currentShipContext = "Frigate"
        elseif (contains(lineLower, "cruiser") or contains(lineLower, "carrier")) and contains(line, "pts]") then
            currentShipContext = "Cruiser"
        end

        if line:sub(1, 1) == "•" or line:sub(1, 1) == "-" or line:sub(1, 1) == "*" then
            line = trimString(line:sub(2))
        end

        if line:sub(1, 3) == "Lvl" then
            local entry = parseAdmiralLine(line)
            if entry then
                entry.shipContext = nil
                table.insert(entries, entry)
            end
        else
            local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
            if colonPos then
                local upgradesText = trimString(line:sub(colonPos + 1))
                local upgradeItems = splitByComma(upgradesText)

                for _, item in ipairs(upgradeItems) do
                    local entry = parseUpgradeItem(item)
                    if entry then
                        entry.shipContext = currentShipContext
                        table.insert(entries, entry)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        ::continue::
    end

    return entries
end

function isHeaderLine(line)
    if #line == 0 then return true end
    if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

    local lowerLine = line:lower()

    if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
       contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
       contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
       contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
        return true
    end

    if contains(line, "##") and contains(lowerLine, "groups") then
        return true
    end

    if contains(line, "##") and contains(lowerLine, "admirals") then
        return true
    end

    if contains(line, " - ") and contains(line, "pts]") and not contains(line, ":") then
        return true
    end

    if contains(line, "[") and contains(line, "pts]") and not contains(line, "•") then
        local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
        if not colonPos then
            return true
        else
            local afterColon = trimString(line:sub(colonPos + 1))
            if #afterColon < 5 then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function parseAdmiralLine(line)
    line = trimString(line)

    local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")

    if bracketPos then
        local admiralName = trimString(line:sub(1, bracketPos - 1))

        if #admiralName > 3 then
            return {name = admiralName, quantity = 1}
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function splitByComma(text)
    local items = {}
    local currentItem = ""
    local inBracket = false

    for i = 1, #text do
        local char = text:sub(i, i)

        if char == "[" then
            inBracket = true
        elseif char == "]" then
            inBracket = false
        elseif char == "," and not inBracket then
            if #currentItem > 0 then
                table.insert(items, currentItem)
                currentItem = ""
            end
            goto continue
        end

        currentItem = currentItem .. char
        ::continue::
    end

    if #currentItem > 0 then
        table.insert(items, currentItem)
    end

    return items
end

function parseUpgradeItem(item)
    item = trimString(item)

    if #item == 0 then return nil end

    local bracketPos = findChar(item, "[")
    if not bracketPos or not contains(item, "pts]") then
        return nil
    end

    local quantity = 1

    local xPos = findChar(item, "x")
    if xPos and xPos < 6 then
        local beforeX = trimString(item:sub(1, xPos - 1))
        if isNumeric(beforeX) then
            quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
            item = trimString(item:sub(xPos + 2))
        end
    end

    bracketPos = findChar(item, "[")
    if bracketPos then
        item = trimString(item:sub(1, bracketPos - 1))
    end

    if #item < 3 then return nil end

    return {name = item, quantity = quantity}
end

function findMatchingCards(searchName, factionFilter, shipContext)
    local matches = {}
    local searchNorm = normalizeForSearch(searchName)

    for i, card in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
        if not factionFilter or card.faction == factionFilter then
            local cardNorm = normalizeForSearch(card.name or "")

            if cardNorm == searchNorm then
                table.insert(matches, i)
            elseif contains(searchNorm, cardNorm) then
                table.insert(matches, i)
            elseif contains(cardNorm, searchNorm) then
                table.insert(matches, i)
            end
        end
    end

    if #matches == 0 and factionFilter and contains(searchNorm, "lvl") then
        local colonPos = findChar(searchName, ":")
        if colonPos then
            local prefix = searchName:sub(1, colonPos)
            local suffix = trimString(searchName:sub(colonPos + 1))
            local factionAdmiralName = prefix .. " " .. factionFilter .. " " .. suffix
            local factionAdmiralNorm = normalizeForSearch(factionAdmiralName)

            for i, card in ipairs(savedUpgradeCards) do
                if not factionFilter or card.faction == factionFilter then
                    local cardNorm = normalizeForSearch(card.name or "")
                    if cardNorm == factionAdmiralNorm then
                        table.insert(matches, i)
                    elseif contains(cardNorm, factionAdmiralNorm) then
                        table.insert(matches, i)
                    elseif contains(factionAdmiralNorm, cardNorm) then
                        table.insert(matches, i)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if #matches > 1 and shipContext then
        local classMatches = {}
        for _, idx in ipairs(matches) do
            local cardClass = getCardClass(savedUpgradeCards[idx])
            if classMatchesContext(cardClass, shipContext) then
                table.insert(classMatches, idx)
            end
        end
        if #classMatches > 0 then
            matches = classMatches
        end
    end

    return matches
end

function trimString(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    local startPos = 1
    while startPos <= #str do
        local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        startPos = startPos + 1
    end
    local endPos = #str
    while endPos >= 1 do
        local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        endPos = endPos - 1
    end
    if startPos > endPos then return "" end
    return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
end

function findChar(str, char)
    for i = 1, #str do
        if str:sub(i, i) == char then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function contains(str, substr)
    if not str or not substr then return false end
    if #substr > #str then return false end
    for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
        local match = true
        for j = 1, #substr do
            if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                match = false
                break
            end
        end
        if match then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function isNumeric(str)
    if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
    for i = 1, #str do
        local char = str:sub(i, i)
        if char < "0" or char > "9" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function getCardClass(card)
    if not card.json then return nil end
    local desc = card.json:match('"Description":%s*"([^"]*)"')
    if desc then
        local class = desc:match("^%[([^%]]+)%]")
        if class then return class:lower() end
    end
    return nil
end

function classMatchesContext(cardClass, shipContext)
    if not cardClass or not shipContext then return true end

    if cardClass == "general" then return true end

    local ctx = shipContext:lower()

    if ctx == "dreadnought" then
        return cardClass == "dreadnought"
    elseif ctx == "heavy" then
        return contains(cardClass, "heavy") or cardClass == "dreadnought"
    elseif ctx == "cruiser" then
        return contains(cardClass, "cruiser")
    elseif ctx == "frigate" then
        return cardClass == "frigate"
    end

    return true
end

function normalizeForSearch(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    str = str:lower()
    str = str:gsub("&", "and")
    str = str:gsub("%s+", " ")
    return trimString(str)
end
